rules.title: No AI for the first 30 minutes of any problem.
rules.body: No Claude, no Copilot, no autocomplete. Pen and paper first, then code.

rules.title: Stuck after 30 minutes? A hint, never the answer.
rules.body: Still stuck after 45: read the solution, close it, write it from memory.

rules.title: Python only.
rules.body: collections (Counter, deque, defaultdict), heapq, bisect, sorting with key=.

rules.title: One line after every problem.
rules.body: The pattern and the trick, in my own words. That line is what I review later.

rules.title: Re-solve on day 1, 3, 7 and 21.
rules.body: A problem counts as learned only after the day-21 re-solve passes in under 25 minutes.

rules.title: Say it out loud.
rules.body: Interviews grade the thinking, not just the code.

dayTypes.name: Minimum
